params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.uri
params.description: Required. The uri of the Cloud Storage object. It's the same uri that is used by gsutil. For example: "gs://bucket_name/object_name". See [Quickstart: Using the gsutil tool] (https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/quickstart-gsutil) for examples.
